name: Run and Cube Side Events NH 2025
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Note that 3X3X3 will NOT be held at this competition - only side events One Handed, 2X2X2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and Clock.
